correctness.rationale: With permutations viewed as functions from positions to symbols and T the identity plus the five cyclic position transpositions, B(g)=gT has size six. A perfect code is an exact cover by these balls and has 20 centers. Branching on one uncovered vertex exhausts every compatible ball that could cover it, discarding only intersections with a chosen ball. An independently written enumeration generated the 120 tuples, made the five position swaps including (4,0), and recursively chose an uncovered point of least compatible degree. It yielded 254 nodes and exactly six covers of size 20. Direct construction of all left cosets of the order-20 affine subgroup gave exactly the same sets, with disjoint balls and full coverage. The stabilizer under left multiplication of A is A, since gA=A is equivalent to g∈A. Frozen verification/verify.py was inspected but not executed. The result is limited to degree five, radius one, and the cyclic position-swap metric.
